changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, code, description) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, 'portal.settlement.manage', 'Submit or withdraw the bank account your company is paid to. A LandVault Super Admin approves it before any payout uses it.'), (gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, 'admin.payouts.manage', 'Approve or reject companies'' payout bank accounts, and send payouts.'); INSERT INTO role_permissions (id, created_at, created_by, deleted, role_id, permission_id) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), now(), 'system', false, r.id, p.id FROM roles r, permissions p WHERE (r.code = 'executive_director' AND p.code = 'portal.settlement.manage') OR (r.code = 'super_admin' AND p.code = 'admin.payouts.manage');
